[Data extraction overview](index.html).

## Scope

The PS resources describe the complete ObServe 10.0 data tree rooted at `ps_common.trip`.

The model contains 40 sheets: the trip, 35 owned entity tables and four membership tables.

Observation, logbook, landing and local-market records remain separate throughout extraction.

The source model and queries are shared by ROS target versions; they contain no ROS recoding or reporting calculations.

[Download the PS source model](../../10.0/ps/form.yaml).

[Download the PS catalogue definitions](../../10.0/ps/references.yaml).

## Ownership and related records

Each query binds `$1::text` to the same selected `ps_common.trip.topiaId`.

Queries follow owning parents to the trip and select only columns from their own table.

Independent collections are extracted separately, preserving every row without multiplication from unrelated joins.

Ownership follows the source model: `wellActivity` belongs to a well and logbook samples belong to a trip.

Other links remain source fields: related observed activities, sample activities, wells and optional survey links.

The model format has one `parent_key`; it does not enforce these additional relationships or their trip consistency.

Every sheet uses its qualified source table name, such as `ps_observation.activity` or `ps_logbook.activity`.

## Fields and references

Queries return fields in model order, with quoted aliases preserving ObServe names such as `topiaId`.

CSV headers occupy row 1; data starts on row 2.

The model preserves source types, nullability, primary keys and the unique activity link of an observed fishing set.

Time-only values remain strings because the form schema has no time-only type; dates and timestamps stay distinct.

Extraction adds no date, timezone, default value or biological interpretation.

Audit/version fields, `homeId` and internal list indexes are excluded, following the LL extraction convention.

Membership tables retain their composite keys and have no invented `topiaId`.

The model declares 59 code lists and four registries, including dependencies of referenced catalogue records.

The four registries are people, vessels, shipowners and vessel size categories.

All 51 directly used catalogue lookups resolve through `ps/references.yaml`, using `topiaid`.

Reference data remain external, configured through `OBSERVE_CODE_LISTS_URL` and `OBSERVE_REGISTRIES_URL`.

See [reference preparation](../03-references/index.html) for the catalogue contract.

## SQL downloads

Queries live in `inst/10.0/ps/sql/`, with one `<schema>.<table>.sql` file per model sheet.

Entity rows are ordered by `topiaId`; memberships are ordered by their complete composite key.

## Source definitions

Table names, columns, keys and foreign keys come from the ObServe 10.0 PostgreSQL schema.

Ownership follows ObServe's parent navigation model, supplemented by the four membership tables.

Source files in `observe-app`:

* `core/persistence/migration/src/main/resources/db/migration/v10/10.0/empty-schema-PG.sql`
* `model/persistence/src/main/resources/META-INF/navigation/Observe-parent-model.json`
